name: Charging Waypoints
description: Time and PTO tracking: timesheets, charge codes, teams and reports.

fields.label: Your email address
fields.help: Sign up with this email first and you become the administrator.

settings.group: Sign in with your company directory (optional)
settings.label: Offer LDAP sign-in
settings.help: These are used until someone saves settings under Admin > LDAP in Charging. After that, what is saved there wins.

settings.label: Directory address

settings.help: The distinguished name (DN) of the account used to look people up.

settings.label: Service account password

settings.group: Sign in with your company directory (optional)
settings.label: Where to search for people

settings.label: Search filter
Offer single sign-on
settings.help: Used until someone saves settings under Admin > OIDC / SSO in Charging. After that, what is saved there wins.

settings.label: Check the directory's certificate
settings.help: Checking needs the certificate to be trusted by the app's container.

settings.label: Trust emails the provider has not verified
settings.help: Only for a provider that never sends email_verified and guarantees the address itself.

settings.label: Allow mail servers on your private network
settings.help: People connect their own outgoing mail server. Turn this on only if reminders must go through a mail relay on your internal network.

settings.label: Database version
settings.help: Only change this for a Raspberry Pi 4 or older. On an install that already has data, switching versions can stop the database from starting.

insideApp: Email cannot be set from the Gateway: each person connects their own outgoing mail server on My Account.
LDAP and single sign-on can also be saved inside Charging, under Admin. What is saved there takes priority over what the Gateway sets.

storage.label: Database
storage.help: Timesheets, PTO and teams. The most important one.

storage.label: Backups
storage.help: Backups. Best kept on a different disk from the database.

storage.label: Secrets
storage.help: Keys the app made for itself. Keep them with your backups.

storage.label: App settings file
storage.help: Settings the app saves for itself.

storage.label: Log files
storage.help: Records of what the app did.

postInstall: Open Charging, sign up with the administrator email you entered, then follow its first-steps page.
